#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    long long W, M;
    cin >> W >> M;
    
    vector<int> B(101, 0);
    long long value = M;
    long long base = W;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        B[i] = value % base;
        value = value / base;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        if (B[i] > 1) {
            B[i] -= base;
            B[i+1]++;
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
        if (B[i] < -1 || B[i] > 1) {
            cout << "NO" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << "YES" << endl;
    return 0;
}
